request.label: outlet-cp4-publish
command:
set -o pipefail
cd "$1"
test -f evidence/task3-launch-hold.json
test ! -e evidence/outlet-cp4.tar.gz
shopt -s nullglob
records=(evidence/outlet-second-collar-plan.json evidence/outlet-b2-*-admission.json
  evidence/outlet-b2-reschedule.json evidence/outlet-worker-amendment.json
  evidence/outlet-worker-authorization.txt evidence/outlet-B2-* evidence/outlet-second-collar-*.json
  evidence/outlet-collar-normal-stress-diagnostic.json evidence/outlet-location-eligibility.json
  evidence/task3-launch-hold.json evidence/b2-affinity.json
  operations/outlet-b2-* operations/outlet-second-collar-* operations/outlet-cp4-publish-analysis*
  science/outlet-b2* tools/outlet-control-v6 tools/outlet-python-v12/h27/task2_outlet_*.py accounting.json)
unique=()
declare -A seen
for path in "${records[@]}"; do
  if test -e "$path" && test ! "${seen[$path]+present}"; then
    seen[$path]=1
    unique+=("$path")
  fi
done
temporary=evidence/outlet-cp4.tar.gz.work-$
test ! -e "$temporary"
trap "rm -f -- \"$temporary\"" EXIT
tar -I "gzip -1" -cf "$temporary" "${unique[@]}"
tar -tzf "$temporary" | awk '$0 == "evidence/task3-launch-hold.json" {located=1} END {exit !located}'
mv -- "$temporary" evidence/outlet-cp4.tar.gz
stat -c "%s bytes %n" evidence/outlet-cp4.tar.gz

from pathlib import Path

from task2r_run import balance,memory_snapshot,memory_headroom

root=Path(sys.argv[1])
baseline=json.loads((root/"evidence/outlet-baseline.json").read_text())
ledger=json.loads((root/"accounting.json").read_text())
live=balance(ledger)
names=["outlet-a-collar.json","outlet-b-collar.json","outlet-collar-effect.json"]
comparisons=[root/"evidence"/n for n in names]
a,b=[json.loads(p.read_text())["comparison"] for p in comparisons[:2]]
assert b["failures"],"B1c does not require a collar-directed refinement"
assert b["second"]["mesh"]==a["second"]["mesh"]
case=accepted_directory(root,"B1c")
receipt=root/"operations"/(case.name+"-steady")/"receipt.json"
meta=json.loads(receipt.read_text())
shape=baseline["M1c"]; old=shape["physical_z_edges"]
rlo,rface,rhi=shape["original_collar_owner_r"]
lo,hi=rlo+.0875,rhi+.0875
between=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(old[:-1],old[1:]) if x>=lo-1e-14 and y<=hi+1e-14]
assert len(between)==4,between
inserted=[(x+y)/2 for x,y in between]
caps=dict(initial_input_and_solve=2029,continuation_input_and_solve=869,assembly_and_pair_and_stations=666,
          final_publication=157,publication_hold=300)
required=sum(caps.values())
assert live["nonprotected_remaining"]>=required,(live,required)
headroom=memory_snapshot(); assert memory_headroom(headroom)>=12*2**30,headroom
peak=max(d.get("peak_tree_rss_bytes",0) for k,d in ledger["entries"].items() if k.startswith("outlet-b1c"))
peak_prediction=peak*(69/65)*1.1
assert peak_prediction<10*2**30,peak_prediction
plan=dict(schema="WJH27SecondCollarRefinementV1",decision="Bisect all four M1c children in the original two collar owner intervals to apply a uniform additional factor two.",
          prior_comparisons=[identity(p) for p in comparisons],base_state=b["second"]["state"],
          x_edges=shape["x_edges"],physical_z_edges=sorted(old+inserted), inserted_r=[x-.0875 for x in inserted],
          levels=[["M1",111,63],["M1c",111,65],["M1cc",111,69]],native_receipt=identity(receipt),
          measured_recent_peak_tree_rss_bytes=peak,forecast_peak_bytes=peak_prediction,memory=headroom,limit_bytes=10*2**30,
          caps_with_grace=caps,required_seconds=required,live_after_admission_reservation=live,
          extra_required_for_staging=max(0,required-live["tranche_remaining"]))
atomic(Path(sys.argv[2]),plan)
print("whole collar refinement",required,plan["extra_required_for_staging"],peak_prediction)

command:
set -euo pipefail
if test ! -f "$1/evidence/outlet-location-eligibility.json"; then
  python3 -B -c '
import json,math,sys
from pathlib import Path
from resources import atomic,identity
from task2r_run import balance,memory_snapshot,memory_headroom,require
from task2_outlet_case import accepted_directory
from task2_outlet_baseline import mesh_axes
from physical_oracle import STATIONS

root=Path(sys.argv[1])
ops=root/"operations"; ev=root/"evidence"
book=json.loads((root/"accounting.json").read_text())
live=balance(book)

def receipt(label):
    return ops/label/"receipt.json"

def operation(label):
    p=receipt(label)
    row=json.loads(p.read_text())["result"]
    return row,identity(p)

def maximum(*labels):
    measured=[operation(label) for label in labels]
    require(all(row["status"]=="PASS" for row,_ in measured),"unsettled extent cost anchor")
    return max(row["seconds"] for row,_ in measured),[digest for _,digest in measured]

def native_chain(directory):
    chain=[]
    while True:
        require(directory not in chain,"cyclic steady guess provenance")
        chain.append(directory)
        inp=json.loads((directory/"inputs.json").read_text())
        guess=Path(inp["initial_guess"]["path"])
        if guess.name!="state.steady-candidate.json":
            break
        require(guess.parent.parent==root/"science" and guess.is_file(),"unexpected typed steady guess")
        directory=guess.parent
    measured=[operation(d.name+"-steady") for d in reversed(chain)]
    require(measured[-1][0]["status"]=="PASS" and all(row["reason"] is None for row,_ in measured),
            "extent cost anchor must reach an accepted final state")
    return sum(row["seconds"] for row,_ in measured),max(row["peak_tree_rss_bytes"] for row,_ in measured),[
        digest for _,digest in measured]

audit_b2=ev/"outlet-B2-audit.json"
ready=(audit_b2.is_file() and (ev/"outlet-second-collar-result.json").is_file()
       and all(x=="MET" for x in json.loads(audit_b2.read_text())["status"].values()))
case="B2" if ready else "B1c"
base=accepted_directory(root,case)
manifest=json.loads((base/"inputs.json").read_text())
xs,zs,_=mesh_axes(Path(manifest["geometry"]["path"]))
terminal_start,old_exit,new_exit=14.375,15.,17.5
breaks=[14.6875,15.,15.375,15.75,16.125,16.5,16.875]
require(xs[-1]==old_exit and terminal_start in xs,"retained grading inventory changed")
new_x=[x for x in xs if x<=terminal_start]+breaks+[x+new_exit-old_exit for x in xs if x>terminal_start]
require(new_x[-1]==new_exit and all(a<b for a,b in zip(new_x,new_x[1:])),
        "prospective downstream mesh is not ordered")
nx,nr=len(new_x)-1,len(zs)-1
ratio=nx/(len(xs)-1)
native,peak,native_receipts=native_chain(base)
build,build_receipts=maximum("outlet-native-build")
parity,parity_receipts=maximum("outlet-a0-replay-steady","outlet-a1-replay-steady")
audit,audit_receipts=maximum("outlet-b2-audit" if ready else "outlet-b1c-audit")
pair,pair_receipts=maximum("outlet-collar-effect")
station,station_receipts=maximum("outlet-b1c-station-witness")
costs=dict(native_and_checkpoint_continuation=math.ceil(native*ratio),
           extension_build=math.ceil(build),retained_case_parity=math.ceil(parity),
           independent_assembly=math.ceil(audit*ratio),
           pairing_and_raw_station_witness=math.ceil((pair+station)*ratio),
           setup_monitoring_and_reservation_grace=100,final_publication=300)
required=sum(costs.values())
memory=memory_snapshot()
peak_forecast=math.ceil(peak*ratio*1.10)
work_fits=live["nonprotected_remaining"]>=required
memory_fits=peak_forecast<=10*2**30 and memory_headroom(memory)>=12*2**30
result=dict(schema="WJH27OutletLocationFeasibilityV2",disposition="FITS" if work_fits and memory_fits else "DEFERRED",
            reasons=[label for label,fits in (("charged_wall_time",work_fits),("memory",memory_fits)) if not fits],
            intended_stationary_test=dict(base=identity(base/"state.result.json"),case=case,
                original_mesh=manifest["geometry"],old_exit_code=old_exit,new_exit_code=new_exit,
                upstream_retained_through=terminal_start,x_edges_code=new_x,physical_z_edges_code=zs,
                interior_x=[-2.5,8.],cells=[nx,nr],stations_code=[*STATIONS,new_exit],
                observation_fields=["U","W","k","R","Pi","Vxr","epsilon","wall_shear"],
                physical_RMS_MAX_limits=dict(U=[.01,.02],W=[.01,.02],k=[.05,.10],epsilon=[.10,.20],
                    wall_shear=[.05,.10]),retained_cell_uncertainty="Compare the signed fixed-region effect with within-B tip and collar indicators on retained physical stations."),
            live_balance=live,complete_forecast_seconds=required,forecast_breakdown=costs,
            charged_wall_time_gap=max(0.,required-live["nonprotected_remaining"]),
            forecast_peak_tree_rss_bytes=peak_forecast,named_physical_limit_bytes=10*2**30,
            host_memory=memory,anchors=native_receipts+build_receipts+parity_receipts+audit_receipts+pair_receipts+station_receipts)
atomic(ev/"outlet-location-eligibility.json",result)
print(result["disposition"],costs,live,result["charged_wall_time_gap"],peak_forecast,flush=True)
' "$1"
fi
if test ! -f "$1/evidence/outlet-collar-normal-stress-diagnostic.json"; then
  python3 -B -c '
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from physical_oracle import full_wj, load_reference
from resources import atomic, identity
from task2_outlet_baseline import read, require

root=Path(sys.argv[1])
evidence=root/"evidence"
table=root/"science/r1-qualified/tables-exact-inner-v1.json"
ref=load_reference(table)
r=.1
s=(r/ref.H-.4)/.35
chi=s**3*(10-15*s+6*s*s)
plane=np.diag([.5,0.,.5])

def owners(rows):
    selected={}
    for point in rows:
        if abs(point["r"]-r)>1e-12:
            continue
        xl,xr,rl,rr=point["bounds"]
        require(abs(rl-r)<1e-12 or abs(rr-r)<1e-12,"collar sample straddles matched radial boundary")
        key=(point["x"],round(xl,12),round(xr,12),"above" if abs(rl-r)<1e-12 else "below")
        require(key not in selected,"duplicate one-sided station")
        selected[key]=point
    return selected

def normal(k, e, gradient):
    full,*_=full_wj([k],[e],gradient[None,:,:])
    return ((1-chi)*2*k/3+chi*np.diag(full[0]))/ref.tau

def shift(a,b):
    G,J=(np.asarray(p["gradient"]) for p in (a,b))
    require(max(abs(np.trace(G)-a["D"]),abs(np.trace(J)-b["D"]))<1e-12,
            "stored planar divergence differs from the raw gradient trace")
    n0=normal(a["k"],a["E"],G)
    nk=normal(b["k"],a["E"],G)
    ne=normal(b["k"],b["E"],G)
    n1=normal(b["k"],b["E"],J)
    raw=(np.diag(b["R"])-np.diag(a["R"]))/ref.tau
    require(float(np.max(abs(raw-n1+n0)))<1e-10,"normal stress shift differed from the original raw samples")
    filtered=normal(b["k"],b["E"],J-b["D"]*plane)-normal(a["k"],a["E"],G-a["D"]*plane)
    return dict(raw=(n1-n0).tolist(), trace_free=filtered.tolist(),k_only=(nk-n0).tolist(),
                E_after_k=(ne-nk).tolist(),gradient_after_k_and_E=(n1-ne).tolist())

payload={}
names=[("A","outlet-a-collar.json"),("B","outlet-b-collar.json")]
if (evidence/"outlet-second-collar-result.json").is_file():
    names.append(("B2","outlet-second-collar-result.json"))
for key,name in names:
    path=evidence/name
    report=read(path)
    coarse,fine=report["case_pair"]
    before,after=(owners(report["samples"][name]) for name in (coarse,fine))
    require(before and before.keys()==after.keys(),"radial owner pairing differs")
    data=[dict(x=key[0],x_interval=list(key[1:3]),radial_side=key[3],
               first=before[key],second=after[key],scaled_shift=shift(before[key],after[key]))
          for key in sorted(before)]
    peaks={field:[max(abs(p["scaled_shift"][field][i]) for p in data) for i in range(3)]
           for field in ("raw","trace_free")}
    payload[key]=dict(input=identity(path),pair=[coarse,fine],maxima=peaks,rows=data)
atomic(evidence/"outlet-collar-normal-stress-diagnostic.json",
       dict(schema="WJH27OutletCollarNormalStressDiagnosticV1",diagnostic_only=True,
            interpretation="Reevaluate the accepted-state samples at r=.1 with the planar trace removed as a scalar sensitivity diagnostic. The telescoping terms depend on substitution order. The accepted solves and numerical comparisons use the original gradients.",
            components=["Rxx","Ryy","Rrr"],normal_stress_scale=ref.tau,radius=r,table=identity(table),data=payload))
print({k:v["maxima"] for k,v in payload.items()},flush=True)
' "$1"
fi
if test ! -f "$1/evidence/task3-launch-hold.json"; then
  python3 -B -c '
import collections,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from resources import atomic,identity
from task2r_run import require

root=Path(sys.argv[1])
evidence=root/"evidence"
ops=root/"operations"

def load(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_text())

def sealed(name):
    return identity(evidence/name)

def paired(name,cases):
    report=load(evidence/name)
    pair=report["comparison"]
    require(report["case_pair"]==cases and len(pair["rows"])==690,"spatial case or inventory differs")
    require(pair["failures"]==[key for key,row in pair["rows"].items() if row["status"]!="MET"],
            "spatial status and failure inventory differ")
    return pair

extent=load(evidence/"outlet-location-eligibility.json")
require(extent["disposition"]=="DEFERRED","check the funded extension before final release")
runtime=load(evidence/"outlet-runtime.json")
baseline=load(evidence/"outlet-baseline.json")
cp3_a=paired("outlet-a-collar.json",["A1","A1c"])
cp3_b=paired("outlet-b-collar.json",["B1","B1c"])
matrix=load(evidence/"outlet-matrix.json")["comparisons"]
cases={}
for policy in ("A","B"):
    screen=matrix[policy+"1-"+policy+"0"]
    collar=cp3_a if policy=="A" else cp3_b
    last=policy+"1c"
    audit=f"outlet-{last}-audit.json"
    status=load(evidence/audit)["status"]
    require(len(screen["rows"])==690 and all(value=="MET" for value in status.values()),"published status differs")
    cases[policy]=dict(policy="FullTractionV1" if policy=="A" else "ZeroTransverseV1",
        default=policy=="A",corner_screen_misses=len(screen["failures"]),first_collar_misses=len(collar["failures"]),
        latest_audited_case=last,latest_state=collar["second"]["state"],latest_mesh=collar["second"]["mesh"],
        current_and_physical_gates=status,latest_audit=sealed(audit))

attempts=[]
affinities={}
for path in [ops/"outlet-b2-steady/receipt.json",*sorted(ops.glob("outlet-b2-continue-*-steady/receipt.json"))]:
    receipt=load(path)
    case=Path(receipt["request"]["command"][-1]).parent

def operation(label):

    return row,identity(p)

def maximum(*labels):
    measured=[operation(label) for label in labels]
    require(all(row["status"]=="PASS" for row,_ in measured),"unsettled extent cost anchor")
    return max(row["seconds"] for row,_ in measured),[digest for _,digest in measured]

def native_chain(directory):

        require(directory not in chain,"cyclic steady guess provenance")
        chain.append(directory)
        inp=json.loads((directory/"inputs.json").read_text())

import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from physical_oracle import full_wj, load_reference
from resources import atomic, identity
from task2_outlet_baseline import read, require

evidence=root/"evidence"
table=root/"science/r1-qualified/tables-exact-inner-v1.json"
ref=load_reference(table)
r=.1
s=(r/ref.H-.4)/.35
chi=s**3*(10-15*s+6*s*s)
plane=np.diag([.5,0.,.5])

def owners(rows):
    selected={}
    for point in rows:
        if abs(point["r"]-r)>1e-12:
            continue
        xl,xr,rl,rr=point["bounds"]
        require(abs(rl-r)<1e-12 or abs(rr-r)<1e-12,"collar sample straddles matched radial boundary")
        key=(point["x"],round(xl,12),round(xr,12),"above" if abs(rl-r)<1e-12 else "below")
        require(key not in selected,"duplicate one-sided station")
        selected[key]=point
    return selected

def normal(k, e, gradient):
    full,*_=full_wj([k],[e],gradient[None,:,:])
    return ((1-chi)*2*k/3+chi*np.diag(full[0]))/ref.tau

def shift(a,b):
    G,J=(np.asarray(p["gradient"]) for p in (a,b))
    require(max(abs(np.trace(G)-a["D"]),abs(np.trace(J)-b["D"]))<1e-12,
            "stored planar divergence differs from the raw gradient trace")
    n0=normal(a["k"],a["E"],G)
    nk=normal(b["k"],a["E"],G)
    ne=normal(b["k"],b["E"],G)
    n1=normal(b["k"],b["E"],J)
    raw=(np.diag(b["R"])-np.diag(a["R"]))/ref.tau
    require(float(np.max(abs(raw-n1+n0)))<1e-10,"normal stress shift differed from the original raw samples")
    filtered=normal(b["k"],b["E"],J-b["D"]*plane)-normal(a["k"],a["E"],G-a["D"]*plane)
    return dict(raw=(n1-n0).tolist(), trace_free=filtered.tolist(),k_only=(nk-n0).tolist(),
                E_after_k=(ne-nk).tolist(),gradient_after_k_and_E=(n1-ne).tolist())

payload={}
names=[("A","outlet-a-collar.json"),("B","outlet-b-collar.json")]
if (evidence/"outlet-second-collar-result.json").is_file():
    names.append(("B2","outlet-second-collar-result.json"))
for key,name in names:
    path=evidence/name
    report=read(path)
    coarse,fine=report["case_pair"]
    before,after=(owners(report["samples"][name]) for name in (coarse,fine))
    require(before and before.keys()==after.keys(),"radial owner pairing differs")
    data=[dict(x=key[0],x_interval=list(key[1:3]),radial_side=key[3],
               first=before[key],second=after[key],scaled_shift=shift(before[key],after[key]))
          for key in sorted(before)]
    peaks={field:[max(abs(p["scaled_shift"][field][i]) for p in data) for i in range(3)]
           for field in ("raw","trace_free")}
    payload[key]=dict(input=identity(path),pair=[coarse,fine],maxima=peaks,rows=data)
atomic(evidence/"outlet-collar-normal-stress-diagnostic.json",
       dict(schema="WJH27OutletCollarNormalStressDiagnosticV1",diagnostic_only=True,
            interpretation="Reevaluate the accepted-state samples at r=.1 with the planar trace removed as a scalar sensitivity diagnostic. The telescoping terms depend on substitution order. The accepted solves and numerical comparisons use the original gradients.",
            components=["Rxx","Ryy","Rrr"],normal_stress_scale=ref.tau,radius=r,table=identity(table),data=payload))
